description.value: Islands Cafe is a Hawaiian surf-culture-inspired coffee roaster and café chain that started as a surfboard company before pivoting to espresso drinks and sandwiches. The company roasts its own green-bean coffee on-site and operates multiple lower-mainland locations, with this node corresponding to the Grandview Corners (Mauka) branch. Touring cyclists will find outdoor seating and a laid-back island atmosphere well-suited to a rest stop on routes through the South Surrey–Tsawwassen corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Islands Cafe is a real, active multi-location coffee roaster and café with a Hawaiian surf theme, operating locations named White Rock (Makai), Grandview Corners (Mauka), and Ocean Park (Pali). The OSM address at 12901 16 Avenue aligns geographically with the Grandview Corners area, consistent with the 'Mauka' branch, though the website does not list per-branch street addresses. No amenity-specific content (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout confirmation) appears in the website text, so those fields are null; OSM supplies outdoor_seating=yes but no other amenity tags.
concerns: Website head-office address (1237 Johnston Rd, White Rock) differs from OSM address (12901 16 Avenue); the OSM node likely represents the 'Grandview Corners | Mauka' branch, but no per-branch street addresses are listed on the website to confirm.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website for this location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café chain with a live website and online shop; the Grandview Corners branch is a publicly accessible food-and-drink stop useful to touring cyclists in the Tsawwassen area.
